-- Verify: show individual moving averages correctly
WITH RECURSIVE date_series(sale_date) AS (
    SELECT DATE '2017-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sale_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    FROM date_series
    WHERE sale_date < DATE '2018-08-29'
),
daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) as sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name
    WHERE pt.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
full_series AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.sale_date,
        COALESCE(daily.daily_sales, 0) as sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ds.sale_date) as day_num
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN daily_sales daily ON ds.sale_date = daily.sale_date
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(sales, day_num) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(sales, day_num) as intercept
    FROM full_series
),
predicted AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE '2018-12-03' + (g * INTERVAL '1' DAY) as sale_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATE '2018-12-03' + (g * INTERVAL '1' DAY)) as day_num,
        r.slope * ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATE '2018-12-03' + (g * INTERVAL '1' DAY)) + r.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM generate_series(0, 7) AS g(g)
    CROSS JOIN regression r
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        p.sale_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) as moving_avg
    FROM predicted p
    JOIN predicted p2 ON p2.day_num BETWEEN p.day_num - 2 AND p.day_num + 2
    WHERE p.sale_date IN ('2018-12-05', '2018-12-06', '2018-12-07', '2018-12-08')
    GROUP BY p.sale_date
)
SELECT * FROM moving_averages ORDER BY sale_date

-- Final RFM analysis with customer_unique_id, showing average sales per order per segment
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts,
        op.payment_value
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
ref_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_ts) AS max_ts FROM delivered_orders
),
customer_rfm AS (
    SELECT 
        d.customer_id,
        CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(d.order_ts), r.max_ts) AS INTEGER) AS recency_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS frequency,
        SUM(d.payment_value) AS monetary
    FROM delivered_orders d
    CROSS JOIN ref_date r
    GROUP BY d.customer_id, r.max_ts
),
rfm_scored AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        cr.customer_id,
        cr.recency_days,
        cr.frequency,
        cr.monetary,
        ROUND(1.0 * cr.monetary / cr.frequency, 2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cr.recency_days ASC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cr.frequency DESC) AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY cr.monetary DESC) AS m_score
    FROM customer_rfm cr
    JOIN customers c ON cr.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
rfm_with_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        CAST(r_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(f_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(m_score AS VARCHAR) AS rfm_cell,
        CASE 
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
              OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scored
)
SELECT 
    rfm_segment,
    customer_count,
    avg_sales_per_order,
    avg_recency_days,
    avg_monetary,
    avg_frequency,
    rfm_cell_range
FROM (
    SELECT 
        rfm_segment,
        COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
        ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) AS avg_recency_days,
        ROUND(AVG(monetary), 2) AS avg_monetary,
        ROUND(AVG(frequency), 2) AS avg_frequency,
        MIN(rfm_cell) || ' - ' || MAX(rfm_cell) AS rfm_cell_range
    FROM rfm_with_segment
    GROUP BY rfm_segment
) sub
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

-- Build the full query: find top 3 customers by avg payment per order
WITH customer_order_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_id,
        SUM(op.payment_value) as order_total_payment
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        cop.customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as num_orders,
        AVG(cop.order_total_payment) as avg_payment_per_order,
        MIN(cop.order_id) as sample_order
    FROM customer_order_payments cop
    GROUP BY cop.customer_id
),
customer_lifespan AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        GREATEST(
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP))) / 86400.0 / 7.0,
            1.0
        ) as lifespan_weeks
    FROM orders o
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    cs.customer_id,
    cs.num_orders,
    cs.avg_payment_per_order,
    cl.lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_stats cs
JOIN customer_lifespan cl ON cs.customer_id = cl.customer_id
ORDER BY cs.avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH player_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    CAST(debut AS DATE) as debut_date,
    CAST(final_game AS DATE) as final_date
  FROM player 
  WHERE debut != '' AND final_game != '' AND debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL
),
raw_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    debut_date,
    final_date,
    (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM debut_date)) as y,
    (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM debut_date)) as m,
    (EXTRACT(DAY FROM final_date) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM debut_date)) as d
  FROM player_dates
),
normalize_d AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id, y, m, d,
    CASE WHEN d < 0 THEN m - 1 ELSE m END as m2,
    CASE WHEN d < 0 THEN d + EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_trunc('month', final_date) - INTERVAL 1 DAY) ELSE d END as d2
  FROM raw_diff
),
normalize_m AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id, y, m2, d2,
    CASE WHEN m2 < 0 THEN y - 1 ELSE y END as years,
    CASE WHEN m2 < 0 THEN m2 + 12 ELSE m2 END as months,
    d2 as days
  FROM normalize_d
),
career_spans AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    years, months, days,
    ROUND(ABS(years), 2) 
      + ROUND(ABS(months), 2) / 12.0 
      + ROUND(ABS(days), 2) / 365.0 as career_span
  FROM normalize_m
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_players, AVG(career_span) as avg_career_span
FROM career_spans

SELECT p.name_given, p.name_first, p.name_last, TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE) as games, TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE) as runs, TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE) as hits, TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE) as hr, TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE), 0) as score FROM batting b JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id WHERE TRY_CAST(b.g AS DOUBLE) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(b.r AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(b.h AS DOUBLE), 0) + COALESCE(TRY_CAST(b.hr AS DOUBLE), 0) = 604.0 ORDER BY score DESC

WITH airport_coords AS (
  SELECT 
    airport_code,
    city,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS longitude,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, LENGTH(CAST(coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - 2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS latitude
  FROM airports_data
),
flights_with_abakan AS (
  SELECT f.flight_id, f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport,
         dep.longitude AS dep_lon, dep.latitude AS dep_lat,
         arr.longitude AS arr_lon, arr.latitude AS arr_lat
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airport_coords dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airport_coords arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
  WHERE f.departure_airport = 'ABA' OR f.arrival_airport = 'ABA'
)
SELECT MAX(
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POW(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
        COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) *
        POW(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
      )
    )
  ) AS max_distance_km
FROM flights_with_abakan

WITH flight_cities AS (
    SELECT 
        dep.city as from_city_raw,
        arr.city as to_city_raw,
        TRY_CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(dep.coordinates::VARCHAR, 2), ',', 1), ')') AS DOUBLE) as dep_lon,
        TRY_CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(dep.coordinates::VARCHAR, 2), ',', 2), ')') AS DOUBLE) as dep_lat,
        TRY_CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(arr.coordinates::VARCHAR, 2), ',', 1), ')') AS DOUBLE) as arr_lon,
        TRY_CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(arr.coordinates::VARCHAR, 2), ',', 2), ')') AS DOUBLE) as arr_lat
    FROM flights f
    JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
city_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(from_city_raw, '"', 4)) as from_city,
        TRIM(SPLIT_PART(to_city_raw, '"', 4)) as to_city,
        6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
            POWER(SIN(RADIANS((dep_lat - arr_lat) / 2)), 2) +
            COS(RADIANS(dep_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(arr_lat)) *
            POWER(SIN(RADIANS((dep_lon - arr_lon) / 2)), 2)
        )) as distance
    FROM flight_cities
),
standardized_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN from_city < to_city THEN from_city ELSE to_city END as city1,
        CASE WHEN from_city < to_city THEN to_city ELSE from_city END as city2,
        distance
    FROM city_pairs
),
avg_distances AS (
    SELECT 
        city1,
        city2,
        AVG(distance) as avg_distance
    FROM standardized_pairs
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
with_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0'
            WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
            ELSE '6000+'
        END as distance_range
    FROM avg_distances
)
SELECT MIN(pair_count) as min_pair_count
FROM (
    SELECT distance_range, COUNT(*) as pair_count
    FROM with_ranges
    GROUP BY distance_range
)

SELECT 
    c.case_id,
    p.party_type,
    p.statewide_vehicle_type,
    p.party_safety_equipment_1,
    p.party_safety_equipment_2,
    p.party_number_killed,
    c.motorcyclist_killed_count
FROM collisions c
JOIN parties p ON c.case_id = p.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
ORDER BY c.case_id, p.party_number

WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year, pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER), pcf_violation_category
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT year, pcf_violation_category, cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM yearly_counts
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT year, GROUP_CONCAT(pcf_violation_category, ', ') AS top_2_causes
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT * FROM top2 ORDER BY year

-- Final answer: percentage point decrease for "speeding" from 2011 to 2021
-- Using all incidents as denominator
WITH yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE)) as year,
        COUNT(*) as total
    FROM collisions
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE)) IN ('2011', '2021')
    GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE))
),
speeding_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE)) as year,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM collisions
    WHERE pcf_violation_category = 'speeding'
    AND STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE)) IN ('2011', '2021')
    GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE))
),
shares AS (
    SELECT 
        s.year,
        s.cnt * 100.0 / t.total as share_pct
    FROM speeding_counts s
    JOIN yearly_totals t ON s.year = t.year
)
SELECT 
    'speeding' as pcf_violation_category,
    ROUND((SELECT share_pct FROM shares WHERE year = '2011'), 2) as share_2011_pct,
    ROUND((SELECT share_pct FROM shares WHERE year = '2021'), 2) as share_2021_pct,
    ROUND((SELECT share_pct FROM shares WHERE year = '2011') - (SELECT share_pct FROM shares WHERE year = '2021'), 2) as percentage_point_decrease

SELECT w_winner.name as winner_name, w_loser.name as loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = b.id
JOIN Wrestlers w_winner ON m.winner_id = w_winner.id
JOIN Wrestlers w_loser ON m.loser_id = w_loser.id
WHERE b.name = 'NXT Championship'
  AND m.title_change = 0
  AND m.duration = '00:43'
LIMIT 1

-- Final query with integer cast for runs_conceded
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler,
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as batsman_runs, 
           COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) as extras, 
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
match_max AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT om.match_id, om.over_id, om.innings_no, om.bowler, om.total_runs, mm.max_runs
    FROM over_runs om
    JOIN match_max mm ON om.match_id = mm.match_id
    WHERE om.total_runs = mm.max_runs
),
bowler_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, MAX(total_runs) as max_over_runs
    FROM max_overs
    GROUP BY bowler
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT bowler, max_over_runs
    FROM bowler_max
    ORDER BY max_over_runs DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT mo.bowler as player_id, p.player_name, mo.match_id, CAST(mo.total_runs AS INTEGER) as runs_conceded
FROM max_overs mo
JOIN top3 t ON mo.bowler = t.bowler AND mo.total_runs = t.max_over_runs
JOIN player p ON mo.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY mo.total_runs DESC

-- Verify: bowler 53 is the only one with 0.0 average
WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
      AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
      AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
      AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, 
           COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
      AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
      AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id 
      AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT br.bowler, p.player_name, br.runs, bw.wickets, 
       ROUND(1.0 * br.runs / bw.wickets, 2) as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE 1.0 * br.runs / bw.wickets = 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH striker_match_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    b.striker,
    b.match_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs_in_match
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT striker
  FROM striker_match_runs
  WHERE total_runs_in_match > 50
),
striker_total_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    smr.striker,
    SUM(smr.total_runs_in_match) as total_runs
  FROM striker_match_runs smr
  INNER JOIN qualifying_strikers qs ON smr.striker = qs.striker
  GROUP BY smr.striker
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as avg_total_runs
FROM striker_total_runs

-- Get distinct player names who scored >= 100 runs in a match while playing for the losing team
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.match_id,
        bbb.striker AS player_id,
        bbb.team_batting AS team_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
      ON bs.match_id = bbb.match_id
      AND bs.over_id = bbb.over_id
      AND bs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id
      AND bs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bs.match_id, bbb.striker, bbb.team_batting
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.player_name
FROM player_match_runs pmr
JOIN match m ON pmr.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pmr.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pmr.team_id != m.match_winner
  AND pmr.total_runs >= 100
ORDER BY p.player_name

-- Re-run the full query to verify
WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
        AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
        AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
        AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    WHERE bbs.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY bbb.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) as matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    WHERE pm.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    WHERE wt.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM season5_matches)
    AND player_out IN (SELECT player_id FROM player)
    GROUP BY player_out
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    pm.player_id,
    pm.matches_played,
    COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    ROUND(pr.total_runs * 1.0 / pm.matches_played, 4) as avg_runs_per_match,
    COALESCE(pd.dismissals, 0) as dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pd.dismissals, 0) > 0 
         THEN ROUND(pr.total_runs * 1.0 / pd.dismissals, 4) 
         ELSE NULL 
    END as batting_average
FROM player_matches pm
JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON pm.player_id = pr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pm.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Now let me also verify that the question interpretation is correct. The question says:
-- "for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played"
-- "then compute the average of these player averages for each country"
-- 
-- This is exactly what we're doing:
-- 1. For each player: total_runs / num_matches (average runs per match)
-- 2. For each country: AVG of those player averages
-- 3. Top 5 countries by this country batting average
--
-- The result looks correct. Let me submit it.
-- But first, let me make sure we return the right format - the question asks for country name and the average.

WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as num_matches
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        p.country_name,
        COALESCE(pr.total_runs, 0) * 1.0 / pm.num_matches as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player p
    LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON p.player_id = pr.player_id
    LEFT JOIN player_matches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
)
SELECT country_name, AVG(avg_runs_per_match) as country_batting_average
FROM player_avg

WITH ordered AS (

    LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_city,
    LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_zip,
    LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lat,
    LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lng
  FROM olist_geolocation
),
with_dist AS (
  SELECT
    prev_state, prev_city, prev_zip, prev_lat, prev_lng,
    geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng,
    6371 * acos(
      GREATEST(-1, LEAST(1, 
        cos(prev_lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * cos(geolocation_lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * cos((geolocation_lng - prev_lng) * 3.141592653589793 / 180) + 
        sin(prev_lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * sin(geolocation_lat * 3.141592653589793 / 180)
      ))
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM ordered
  WHERE prev_state IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  prev_state AS state_1,
  prev_city AS city_1,
  prev_zip AS zip_1,
  prev_lat AS lat_1,
  prev_lng AS lng_1,
  geolocation_state AS state_2,
  geolocation_city AS city_2,
  geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip_2,
  geolocation_lat AS lat_2,

FROM with_dist

           SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN promotions pr ON s.promo_id = pr.promo_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND pr.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    GROUP BY p.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
sales_pivot AS (
    SELECT prod_id, calendar_month_number,
           MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2019,
           MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM monthly_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) IS NOT NULL
       AND MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) IS NOT NULL
),
projected AS (
    SELECT prod_id, calendar_month_number, sales_2019, sales_2020,
           CASE WHEN sales_2019 > 0 
                THEN sales_2020 + ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) / sales_2019) * sales_2020
                ELSE sales_2020 
           END as projected_2021
    FROM sales_pivot
),
projected_with_currency AS (
    SELECT p.prod_id, p.calendar_month_number, p.projected_2021,
           c.to_us,
           p.projected_2021 * c.to_us as projected_usd
    FROM projected p
    JOIN currency c ON p.calendar_month_number = c.month 
                    AND 2021 = c.year
                    AND c.country = 'France'
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT calendar_month_number,
           ROUND(AVG(projected_usd), 2) as avg_monthly_usd
    FROM projected_with_currency
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT avg_monthly_usd,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_monthly_usd) as rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () as total
    FROM monthly_averages
)
SELECT AVG(avg_monthly_usd) as median_projected_sales_usd
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN (CAST((total + 1) / 2 AS INTEGER), CAST((total + 2) / 2 AS INTEGER))

WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT p.cust_id,
           SUM(p.quantity_sold * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) as total_profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
      AND p.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND p.time_id <= '2021-12-31'
    GROUP BY p.cust_id
),
profit_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) as min_val, MAX(total_profit) as max_val FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT cp.cust_id, cp.total_profit,
           CASE 
             WHEN pr.max_val = pr.min_val THEN 1
             ELSE NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY cp.total_profit)
           END as bucket
    FROM customer_profits cp, profit_range pr
)
SELECT 
    bucket,
    COUNT(*) as num_customers,
    ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) as min_profit,
    ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) as max_profit
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

-- Final result: highest and lowest profits per tier
WITH italian_customers AS (

  FROM customers c 
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id

),
customer_profits AS (

tiered AS (

WITH dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS dt
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn'
    AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01'
    AND insert_date <= '2021-07-31'
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT dt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dt) AS rn
  FROM dates
),
groups AS (
  SELECT dt,
         dt - CAST(rn AS INTEGER) AS grp
  FROM numbered
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_length, MIN(dt) AS start_date, MAX(dt) AS end_date
  FROM groups
  GROUP BY grp
),
streak_info AS (
  SELECT s.grp, s.streak_length, s.start_date, s.end_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.streak_length DESC, s.start_date) AS longest_rank,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.streak_length ASC, s.start_date) AS shortest_rank
  FROM streaks s
),
streak_dates AS (
  SELECT d.dt
  FROM dates d
  INNER JOIN streak_info si ON d.dt >= si.start_date AND d.dt <= si.end_date
  WHERE si.longest_rank = 1 OR si.shortest_rank = 1
),
city_ranked AS (
  SELECT c.city_name, CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) AS dt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.insert_date ORDER BY c.city_id) AS rn
  FROM cities c
  WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'cn'
    AND c.insert_date >= '2021-07-01'
    AND c.insert_date <= '2021-07-31'
)
SELECT cr.dt AS date,
       UPPER(SUBSTRING(cr.city_name, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTRING(cr.city_name, 2)) AS city_name
FROM city_ranked cr
INNER JOIN streak_dates sd ON cr.dt = sd.dt
WHERE cr.rn = 1
ORDER BY cr.dt

-- Final answer: countries with the longest streak of consecutive inserted city dates in June 2022
WITH june_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, 
           CAST(insert_date AS DATE) as insert_date
    FROM cities
    WHERE insert_date >= '2022-06-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-06-30'
),
numbered AS (

    FROM june_dates
),
streaks AS (

           insert_date - INTERVAL (rn) DAY as streak_group
    FROM numbered
),
streak_lengths AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, streak_group, COUNT(*) as streak_length
    FROM streaks
    GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_group
),
max_streaks AS (

SELECT country_code_2

-- Final answer: country with 9 different insertion days in Jan 2022,
-- its longest consecutive period, and proportion of capital entries in that period
WITH ir_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(insert_date AS DATE) as dt
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 = 'ir'
    AND insert_date >= '2022-01-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-01-31'
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT dt,
         dt - CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dt) AS INTEGER) AS grp
  FROM ir_dates
),
consecutive AS (
  SELECT grp, MIN(dt) as start_date, MAX(dt) as end_date, COUNT(*) as length
  FROM grouped
  GROUP BY grp
),
longest AS (
  SELECT start_date, end_date
  FROM consecutive
  ORDER BY length DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
period_entries AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as capital_entries,
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as proportion
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 = 'ir'
    AND CAST(insert_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT start_date FROM longest)
    AND CAST(insert_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT end_date FROM longest)
)
SELECT 
  c.country_name,
  c.country_code_2,
  l.start_date,
  l.end_date,
  p.proportion
FROM longest l, period_entries p, cities_countries c
WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'ir'

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE))::INTEGER AS year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE))::INTEGER AS month_num,
    CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE))
      WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
    END AS month_name,
    COUNT(*) AS city_count
  FROM cities
  WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) IN (4, 5, 6)
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) IN (2021, 2022, 2023)
  GROUP BY year, month_num, month_name
),
with_running_total AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month_num,
    month_name,
    city_count,
    CAST(SUM(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS INTEGER) AS running_total
  FROM monthly_counts
),
with_growth AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month_num,
    month_name,
    city_count,
    running_total,
    ROUND(100.0 * (city_count - LAG(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year)) / LAG(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year), 2) AS monthly_growth_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * (running_total - LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year)) / LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year), 2) AS running_total_growth_pct
  FROM with_running_total
)
SELECT 
  year,
  month_name,
  city_count,
  running_total,
  monthly_growth_pct,
  running_total_growth_pct
FROM with_growth
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY year, month_num

WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time) as row_id,
        order_id, 
        customer_id, 
        pizza_id,
        exclusions, 
        extras, 
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
pizza_info AS (
    SELECT b.*, pn.pizza_name, pr.toppings as recipe_toppings
    FROM base b
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON b.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON b.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
recipe_topping_names AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.row_id,
        pi.order_id,
        pi.customer_id,
        pi.pizza_id,
        pi.exclusions,
        pi.extras,
        pi.order_time,
        pi.pizza_name,
        pt.topping_name as ingredient
    FROM pizza_info pi
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(1, array_length(string_split(pi.recipe_toppings, ',')))) AS t(n)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON TRIM(split_part(pi.recipe_toppings, ',', t.n))::INTEGER = pt.topping_id
),
excluded_topping_names AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.row_id,
        pt.topping_name as ingredient
    FROM pizza_info pi
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(1, array_length(string_split(pi.exclusions, ',')))) AS t(n)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON TRIM(split_part(pi.exclusions, ',', t.n))::INTEGER = pt.topping_id
    WHERE pi.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND pi.exclusions != ''
),
extra_topping_names AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.row_id,
        pi.order_id,
        pi.customer_id,
        pi.pizza_id,
        pi.exclusions,
        pi.extras,
        pi.order_time,
        pi.pizza_name,
        pt.topping_name as ingredient
    FROM pizza_info pi
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(1, array_length(string_split(pi.extras, ',')))) AS t(n)
    JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON TRIM(split_part(pi.extras, ',', t.n))::INTEGER = pt.topping_id
    WHERE pi.extras IS NOT NULL AND pi.extras != ''
),
all_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        r.row_id,
        r.order_id,
        r.customer_id,
        r.pizza_id,
        r.exclusions,
        r.extras,
        r.order_time,
        r.pizza_name,
        r.ingredient
    FROM recipe_topping_names r
    LEFT JOIN excluded_topping_names e ON r.row_id = e.row_id AND r.ingredient = e.ingredient
    WHERE e.ingredient IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        e.row_id,
        e.order_id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.pizza_id,
        e.exclusions,
        e.extras,
        e.order_time,
        e.pizza_name,
        e.ingredient
    FROM extra_topping_names e
    LEFT JOIN excluded_topping_names ex ON e.row_id = ex.row_id AND e.ingredient = ex.ingredient
    WHERE ex.ingredient IS NULL
),
ingredient_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
        ingredient,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM all_ingredients
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name, ingredient
),
formatted_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
        ingredient,
        cnt,
        CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || ingredient ELSE ingredient END as formatted_ingredient,
        CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as sort_order
    FROM ingredient_counts
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
        string_agg(formatted_ingredient, ', ' ORDER BY sort_order, ingredient) as ingredients_str
    FROM formatted_ingredients
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name
)
SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients_str as ingredients
FROM grouped
ORDER BY row_id

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id

    WHERE cancellation IS NULL OR cancellation = ''
),
distinct_pizzas AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
),
pizza_counts AS (

    FROM distinct_pizzas
    GROUP BY order_id
),
base_toppings AS (
    SELECT dp.order_id, dp.pizza_id,
           CAST(TRIM(unnest(string_split(pr.toppings, ','))) AS BIGINT) as topping_id
    FROM distinct_pizzas dp
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON dp.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
extras_per_pizza AS (
    SELECT pe.order_id, dp.pizza_id, pe.extras as topping_id, 
           CAST(pe.extras_count AS DOUBLE) / pc.num_pizzas as qty
    FROM pizza_get_extras pe
    JOIN distinct_pizzas dp ON pe.order_id = dp.order_id
    JOIN pizza_counts pc ON pe.order_id = pc.order_id
),
exclusions_per_pizza AS (
    SELECT pe.order_id, dp.pizza_id, pe.exclusions as topping_id, 
           CAST(pe.total_exclusions AS DOUBLE) / pc.num_pizzas as qty
    FROM pizza_get_exclusions pe
    JOIN distinct_pizzas dp ON pe.order_id = dp.order_id
    JOIN pizza_counts pc ON pe.order_id = pc.order_id
)
SELECT 'base' as source, bt.order_id, bt.pizza_id, bt.topping_id, 1 as qty
FROM base_toppings bt
UNION ALL
SELECT 'extra' as source, ep.order_id, ep.pizza_id, ep.topping_id, ep.qty
FROM extras_per_pizza ep
UNION ALL
SELECT 'exclusion' as source, ep.order_id, ep.pizza_id, ep.topping_id, -ep.qty
FROM exclusions_per_pizza ep
ORDER BY source, order_id, pizza_id, topping_id

SELECT

WITH months AS (
  SELECT unnest(generate_series(0, 3)) as n
),
months_expanded AS (
  SELECT DATE '2020-01-01' + (n * INTERVAL '1' MONTH) as month_start
  FROM months
),
customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
all_customer_months AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_start
  FROM customers c
  CROSS JOIN months_expanded m
),
monthly_net AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date::DATE) as month_str,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END) as monthly_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date::DATE)
)
SELECT 
  acm.customer_id,
  strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(acm.month_start AS DATE)) as month,
  COALESCE(mn.monthly_change, 0) as monthly_change,
  SUM(COALESCE(mn.monthly_change, 0)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY acm.customer_id 
    ORDER BY acm.month_start
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) as cumulative_balance
FROM all_customer_months acm
LEFT JOIN monthly_net mn 
  ON acm.customer_id = mn.customer_id 
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(acm.month_start AS DATE)) = mn.month_str
ORDER BY acm.customer_id, acm.month_start

-- Final query with ROUND for clean output
WITH all_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month_year
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
),
all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_month_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        m.month_year,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
                 SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM all_customers c
    CROSS JOIN all_months m
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct 
        ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id 
        AND m.month_year = substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 7)
        AND substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
        AND ct.txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, m.month_year
),
monthly_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 END) as positive_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM customer_month_balance
    GROUP BY month_year
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        positive_count,
        avg_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) as highest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) as lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE highest_rank = 1) - 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE lowest_rank = 1) as difference
FROM ranked_months
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE))
),
with_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        monthly_net,
        SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS closing_balance
    FROM monthly_nets
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        monthly_net,
        closing_balance,
        LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_balance
    FROM with_balance
),
most_recent AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start AS most_recent_month,
        closing_balance,
        prev_balance,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_balance IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN prev_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
            ELSE (closing_balance - prev_balance) * 100.0 / prev_balance
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM with_prev
    WHERE month_start = (SELECT MAX(month_start) FROM with_balance wb WHERE wb.customer_id = with_prev.customer_id)
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total,
    COUNT(growth_rate) as with_rate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as above_5,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as pct_all,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(growth_rate) as pct_with_rate
FROM most_recent

WITH month_starts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month_date 
    FROM customer_transactions
),
user_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        m.month_date,
        ct.customer_id,
        SUM(ct.txn_amount * CASE 
            WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN 1
            WHEN ct.txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -1
            WHEN ct.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -1
            ELSE 0
        END) as balance
    FROM month_starts m
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions) users
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct 
        ON ct.customer_id = users.customer_id 
        AND CAST(ct.txn_date AS DATE) <= m.month_date
    GROUP BY m.month_date, ct.customer_id
),
total_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        month_date,
        SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(balance, 0), 0)) as total_balance_no_negative
    FROM user_balances
    GROUP BY month_date
),
shifted AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.month_date as month,
        t2.total_balance_no_negative as prev_month_total_balance
    FROM total_balances t1
    LEFT JOIN total_balances t2 
        ON t2.month_date = (t1.month_date - INTERVAL '1' MONTH)
    WHERE t1.month_date != (SELECT MIN(month_date) FROM total_balances)
)
SELECT 
    month as month,
    prev_month_total_balance
FROM shifted 
ORDER BY month

WITH all_dates_gen AS (
    SELECT DATE '2020-01-01' + i * INTERVAL '1 day' as txn_date
    FROM generate_series(0, 120) AS g(i)
),
all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
cust_date AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, d.txn_date
    FROM all_customers c
    CROSS JOIN all_dates_gen d
    WHERE d.txn_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-04-28'
),
daily_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) as daily_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT cd.customer_id, cd.txn_date, COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0) as daily_net
    FROM cust_date cd
    LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON cd.customer_id = dn.customer_id AND cd.txn_date = dn.txn_date
),
running_bal AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, daily_net,
        SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as running_balance
    FROM daily_balances
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, running_balance,
        AVG(running_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date 
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as rolling_avg_balance
    FROM running_bal
),
rolling_avg_30 AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, running_balance, rolling_avg_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as day_num
    FROM rolling_avg
),
rolling_filtered AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, running_balance, rolling_avg_balance
    FROM rolling_avg_30
    WHERE day_num >= 30
),
rolling_clamped AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, running_balance,
        GREATEST(rolling_avg_balance, 0) as rolling_avg_balance
    FROM rolling_filtered
),
first_months AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
        date_trunc('month', MIN(txn_date)::DATE) as first_month
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
with_first_month AS (
    SELECT rf.*, fm.first_month
    FROM rolling_clamped rf
    JOIN first_months fm ON rf.customer_id = fm.customer_id
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, running_balance, rolling_avg_balance, first_month
    FROM with_first_month
    WHERE date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) != first_month
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month,
        MAX(rolling_avg_balance) as max_rolling_avg
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
monthly_sum AS (
    SELECT month, SUM(max_rolling_avg) as total_max_avg
    FROM monthly_max
    GROUP BY month
    ORDER BY month
)
SELECT month, total_max_avg FROM monthly_sum

WITH daily_changes AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type IN ('purchase', 'withdrawal') THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) as daily_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_ranges AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date)::DATE as min_date, MAX(txn_date)::DATE as max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
date_series AS (
    SELECT (DATE '2020-01-01' + seq * INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE as dt
    FROM generate_series(0, 120) as t(seq)
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT cr.customer_id, ds.dt as txn_date
    FROM customer_ranges cr
    CROSS JOIN date_series ds
    WHERE ds.dt >= cr.min_date AND ds.dt <= cr.max_date
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.txn_date,
           COALESCE(dc.daily_change, 0) as daily_change,
           SUM(COALESCE(dc.daily_change, 0)) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ad.customer_id 
               ORDER BY ad.txn_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) as running_balance
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes dc ON ad.customer_id = dc.customer_id AND ad.txn_date = dc.txn_date
),
daily_balances_capped AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
           GREATEST(running_balance, 0) as capped_balance
    FROM daily_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date)::INTEGER as calendar_year,
           EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date)::INTEGER as month_number,
           MAX(capped_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM daily_balances_capped
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date)::INTEGER, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date)::INTEGER
)
SELECT calendar_year, month_number, SUM(max_daily_balance) as monthly_total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY calendar_year, month_number
ORDER BY calendar_year, month_number

-- Build full query with quintile labels and sort
WITH english_completed AS (
    SELECT ss.StudentID, ss.Grade
    FROM Student_Schedules ss
    JOIN Classes c ON ss.ClassID = c.ClassID
    JOIN Subjects sub ON c.SubjectID = sub.SubjectID
    JOIN Categories cat ON sub.CategoryID = cat.CategoryID
    WHERE cat.CategoryDescription = 'English'
      AND ss.ClassStatus = 2
),
total_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM english_completed
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT ec.StudentID, ec.Grade,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_completed ec2 WHERE ec2.Grade >= ec.Grade) as rank_val,
           (SELECT total FROM total_count) as total
    FROM english_completed ec
),
with_quintile AS (
    SELECT r.StudentID, r.Grade, r.rank_val, r.total,
           1.0 * r.rank_val / r.total as quintile_rank,
           CASE
               WHEN 1.0 * r.rank_val / r.total <= 0.2 THEN 'First'
               WHEN 1.0 * r.rank_val / r.total <= 0.4 THEN 'Second'
               WHEN 1.0 * r.rank_val / r.total <= 0.6 THEN 'Third'
               WHEN 1.0 * r.rank_val / r.total <= 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
               ELSE 'Fifth'
           END as quintile_label,
           CASE
               WHEN 1.0 * r.rank_val / r.total <= 0.2 THEN 1
               WHEN 1.0 * r.rank_val / r.total <= 0.4 THEN 2
               WHEN 1.0 * r.rank_val / r.total <= 0.6 THEN 3
               WHEN 1.0 * r.rank_val / r.total <= 0.8 THEN 4
               ELSE 5
           END as quintile_order
    FROM ranked r
)
SELECT wq.quintile_label, wq.quintile_order, s.StudLastName, wq.Grade, ROUND(wq.quintile_rank, 4) as quintile_rank
FROM with_quintile wq
JOIN Students s ON wq.StudentID = s.StudentID
ORDER BY wq.quintile_order, wq.Grade DESC

-- Build the comparison of annual sales vs annual quota per salesperson per year
WITH annual_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) AS salespersonid,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) AS annual_sales
    FROM salesorderheader
    WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL AND salespersonid != ''
    GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER)
),
annual_quota AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER) AS salespersonid,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) AS annual_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT 
    a.salespersonid,
    a.year,
    ROUND(a.annual_sales, 2) AS annual_sales,
    ROUND(q.annual_quota, 2) AS annual_quota,
    ROUND(a.annual_sales - q.annual_quota, 2) AS difference
FROM annual_sales a
JOIN annual_quota q ON a.salespersonid = q.salespersonid AND a.year = q.year
ORDER BY a.salespersonid, a.year

WITH director_movies AS (

with_prev_date AS (

    FROM director_movies
),
inter_movie_durations AS (

        CASE

    FROM with_prev_date

director_ratings AS (

combined AS (

        dr.avg_rating,
        dr.total_votes,
        dr.min_rating,

)
SELECT 
    name_id,

WITH region_year_totals AS (
    SELECT bm.region, SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, 7, 4) as year, 
           SUM(bt.quantity * bp.price) as total_dollar_amount,
           SUM(bt.quantity) as total_quantity,
           SUM(bt.quantity * bp.price) / SUM(bt.quantity) as avg_purchase_price
    FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
    JOIN bitcoin_members bm ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bt.ticker = bp.ticker AND bt.txn_date = bp.market_date
    WHERE bt.ticker = 'BTC' AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'
    GROUP BY bm.region, SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, 7, 4)
),
with_first_year AS (
    SELECT *, 
           MIN(year) OVER (PARTITION BY region) as first_year
    FROM region_year_totals
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT region, year, total_dollar_amount, total_quantity, avg_purchase_price
    FROM with_first_year
    WHERE year != first_year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT region, year, total_dollar_amount, total_quantity, avg_purchase_price,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) as price_rank
    FROM filtered
),
with_pct_change AS (
    SELECT region, year, total_dollar_amount, total_quantity, avg_purchase_price, price_rank,
           LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY year) as prev_avg_price
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT region, year, 
       ROUND(avg_purchase_price, 2) as avg_purchase_price,
       price_rank,
       ROUND(prev_avg_price, 2) as prev_year_avg_price,
       ROUND(1.0 * (avg_purchase_price - prev_avg_price) / prev_avg_price * 100, 2) as pct_change
FROM with_pct_change
ORDER BY year, price_rank

-- Build full query with LAG for previous day volume and pct change
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        market_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
            WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000000
            WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
            ELSE TRY_CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)
        END AS volume_num
    FROM bitcoin_prices
    WHERE market_date IN ('01-08-2021','02-08-2021','03-08-2021','04-08-2021','05-08-2021','06-08-2021','07-08-2021','08-08-2021','09-08-2021','10-08-2021')
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        market_date,
        volume_num,
        LAG(volume_num) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY market_date) AS prev_volume
    FROM parsed
)
SELECT 
    ticker,
    market_date,
    volume_num,
    prev_volume,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_volume IS NULL OR prev_volume = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 1.0 * (volume_num - prev_volume) / prev_volume * 100
    END AS pct_change
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY ticker, market_date

WITH customer_first_payment AS (

customer_ltv AS (

    FROM payment

customer_7day AS (

    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first_payment cf ON p.customer_id = cf.customer_id
    WHERE p.payment_date >= cf.first_payment
      AND p.payment_date < cf.first_payment + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
),
customer_30day AS (

    WHERE p.payment_date >= cf.first_payment
      AND p.payment_date < cf.first_payment + INTERVAL '30' DAY
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN cl.total_ltv > 0 THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(c7.amount_7day, 0) / cl.total_ltv * 100 ELSE 0 END) as avg_pct_7day,
    AVG(CASE WHEN cl.total_ltv > 0 THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(c30.amount_30day, 0) / cl.total_ltv * 100 ELSE 0 END) as avg_pct_30day,

WITH team_season_goals AS (

    FROM Match
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id, season

    FROM Match
    GROUP BY away_team_api_id, season

ranked AS (

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY highest_goals) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
    FROM highest_season_goals
)

    FROM Match m
),

    FROM team_matches

),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id, 
    mth, 
    qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) AS month_num
  FROM monthly_sales 
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    b.*,
    (SELECT AVG(b2.qty * 1.0) FROM base b2 
     WHERE b2.product_id = b.product_id AND b2.time_step BETWEEN b.time_step - 5 AND b.time_step + 6) AS window1_avg,
    (SELECT AVG(b2.qty * 1.0) FROM base b2 
     WHERE b2.product_id = b.product_id AND b2.time_step BETWEEN b.time_step - 6 AND b.time_step + 5) AS window2_avg
  FROM base b
),
with_cma AS (
  SELECT *, (window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0 AS cma
  FROM cma_calc
),
seasonality AS (
  SELECT *, 
         CASE WHEN cma != 0 THEN qty * 1.0 / cma ELSE NULL END AS ratio
  FROM with_cma
  WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
seasonal_indices AS (
  SELECT product_id, month_num, AVG(ratio) AS seasonal_index
  FROM seasonality
  GROUP BY product_id, month_num
),
deseasonalized AS (
  SELECT w.*,
         CASE WHEN si.seasonal_index != 0 AND si.seasonal_index IS NOT NULL THEN w.qty * 1.0 / si.seasonal_index ELSE NULL END AS trend
  FROM with_cma w
  LEFT JOIN seasonal_indices si ON w.product_id = si.product_id AND w.month_num = si.month_num
),
weighted_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(cma) AS sum_w,
    SUM(cma * time_step) AS sum_wx,
    SUM(cma * trend) AS sum_wy,
    SUM(cma * time_step * time_step) AS sum_wxx,
    SUM(cma * time_step * trend) AS sum_wxy
  FROM deseasonalized
  WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30 AND trend IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY product_id
),
regression_params AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    (sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) / (sum_w * sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx) AS slope,
    (sum_wy - ((sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) / (sum_w * sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx)) * sum_wx) / sum_w AS intercept
  FROM weighted_stats
),
forecast AS (
  SELECT 
    b.product_id,
    b.time_step,
    b.month_num,
    rp.slope,
    rp.intercept,
    rp.slope * b.time_step + rp.intercept AS forecast_trend,
    si.seasonal_index,
    CASE WHEN si.seasonal_index != 0 THEN (rp.slope * b.time_step + rp.intercept) * si.seasonal_index ELSE 0 END AS forecast_qty
  FROM base b
  JOIN regression_params rp ON b.product_id = rp.product_id
  LEFT JOIN seasonal_indices si ON b.product_id = si.product_id AND b.month_num = si.month_num
  WHERE b.time_step BETWEEN 25 AND 36
)
SELECT

  ROUND(SUM(forecast_qty), 2) AS avg_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM forecast
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

    SELECT

        m.mth,
        im.ending_inv AS beginning_inv,
        COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) AS demand,
        p.qty_minimum,
        p.qty_purchase,
        im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) AS pre_restock_inv,
        CASE WHEN im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) < p.qty_minimum 
             THEN im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) + p.qty_purchase
             ELSE im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0)
        END AS ending_inv
    FROM inv_model im
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = im.product_id
    JOIN months m ON m.mth = im.mth + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget mb ON mb.product_id = im.product_id AND mb.mth = m.mth
    WHERE m.mth <= DATE '2019-12-01'
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, ending_inv, qty_minimum,
           ABS(ending_inv - qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
    FROM inv_model
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM with_diff
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY abs_diff ASC, mth ASC) = 1
ORDER BY product_id

WITH match_points AS (

        END as points

ranked AS (

WITH items AS (

    "loss_rate_%" AS lr

),
stats AS (

)
SELECT 
  s.avg_loss_rate,
  s.std_dev_loss_rate,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN i.lr < s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 END) AS count_below,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN i.lr >= s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_dev_loss_rate 
              AND i.lr <= s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_dev_loss_rate THEN 1 END) AS count_within,

WITH wholesale AS (

        ROUND(MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
        ROUND(SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(w.whsle_date, ' ', 1) AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(w.whsle_date, ' ', 1) AS DATE))::INT, c.category_name, c.item_code
),
wholesale_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        year,

        ROUND(AVG(avg_wholesale_price), 2) as avg_wholesale_price,

        ROUND(MIN(min_wholesale_price), 2) as min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(max_wholesale_price) - MIN(min_wholesale_price), 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
        ROUND(SUM(total_wholesale_price), 2) as total_wholesale_price
    FROM wholesale
    GROUP BY year, category_name
),
selling AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, ' ', 1) AS DATE))::INT as year,
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t."sale/return" = 'sale' THEN t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" ELSE 0 END), 2) as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, ' ', 1) AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(SPLIT_PART(t.txn_date, ' ', 1) AS DATE))::INT, c.category_name
),
loss AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(l."loss_rate_%"), 2) as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df l
    JOIN veg_cat c ON l.item_code = c.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
    wa.year,
    wa.category_name,
    wa.avg_wholesale_price,
    wa.max_wholesale_price,
    wa.min_wholesale_price,
    wa.wholesale_price_difference,
    wa.total_wholesale_price,
    s.total_selling_price,
    l.avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(wa.total_wholesale_price * l.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(s.total_selling_price - wa.total_wholesale_price, 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_agg wa
JOIN selling s ON wa.year = s.year AND wa.category_name = s.category_name
JOIN loss l ON wa.category_name = l.category_name
ORDER BY wa.year, wa.category_name

-- Calculate total sales for pre and post periods, and percentage change
WITH year_weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT calendar_year, week_date, week_number
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
),
pre_june AS (
    SELECT calendar_year, week_date, week_number,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year ORDER BY week_date DESC) as rn
    FROM year_weeks
    WHERE week_date < calendar_year || '-06-15'
),
post_june AS (
    SELECT calendar_year, week_date, week_number,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year ORDER BY week_date ASC) as rn
    FROM year_weeks
    WHERE week_date > calendar_year || '-06-15'
),
pre_sales AS (
    SELECT cws.calendar_year, SUM(cws.sales) as total_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales cws
    JOIN pre_june pj ON cws.calendar_year = pj.calendar_year AND cws.week_date = pj.week_date
    WHERE pj.rn <= 4
    GROUP BY cws.calendar_year
),
post_sales AS (
    SELECT cws.calendar_year, SUM(cws.sales) as total_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales cws
    JOIN post_june pj ON cws.calendar_year = pj.calendar_year AND cws.week_date = pj.week_date
    WHERE pj.rn <= 4
    GROUP BY cws.calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    ps.calendar_year,
    ps.total_sales as pre_sales,
    pts.total_sales as post_sales,
    ROUND(1.0 * (pts.total_sales - ps.total_sales) / ps.total_sales * 100, 2) as pct_change
FROM pre_sales ps
JOIN post_sales pts ON ps.calendar_year = pts.calendar_year
ORDER BY ps.calendar_year

WITH attr_regions AS (
    SELECT 'region' as attr_type, region as attr_value, SUM(sales) as total_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales

),
attr_regions_after AS (

    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number > 25

),
attr_platforms AS (

    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number < 25
    GROUP BY platform
),
attr_platforms_after AS (
    SELECT 'platform' as attr_type, platform as attr_value, SUM(sales) as total_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number > 25
    GROUP BY platform
),
attr_age_bands AS (
    SELECT 'age_band' as attr_type, age_band as attr_value, SUM(sales) as total_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number < 25
    GROUP BY age_band
),
attr_age_bands_after AS (
    SELECT 'age_band' as attr_type, age_band as attr_value, SUM(sales) as total_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number > 25
    GROUP BY age_band
),
attr_demographics AS (
    SELECT 'demographic' as attr_type, demographic as attr_value, SUM(sales) as total_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number < 25
    GROUP BY demographic
),
attr_demographics_after AS (
    SELECT 'demographic' as attr_type, demographic as attr_value, SUM(sales) as total_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number > 25
    GROUP BY demographic
),
attr_customer_types AS (
    SELECT 'customer_type' as attr_type, customer_type as attr_value, SUM(sales) as total_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number < 25
    GROUP BY customer_type
),
attr_customer_types_after AS (
    SELECT 'customer_type' as attr_type, customer_type as attr_value, SUM(sales) as total_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number > 25
    GROUP BY customer_type
),
all_changes AS (
    SELECT ar.attr_type, ar.attr_value, 1.0 * (ara.total_after - ar.total_before) / ar.total_before * 100 as pct_change
    FROM attr_regions ar JOIN attr_regions_after ara ON ar.attr_value = ara.attr_value
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ap.attr_type, ap.attr_value, 1.0 * (apa.total_after - ap.total_before) / ap.total_before * 100 as pct_change
    FROM attr_platforms ap JOIN attr_platforms_after apa ON ap.attr_value = apa.attr_value
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ab.attr_type, ab.attr_value, 1.0 * (aba.total_after - ab.total_before) / ab.total_before * 100 as pct_change
    FROM attr_age_bands ab JOIN attr_age_bands_after aba ON ab.attr_value = aba.attr_value
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ad.attr_type, ad.attr_value, 1.0 * (ada.total_after - ad.total_before) / ad.total_before * 100 as pct_change
    FROM attr_demographics ad JOIN attr_demographics_after ada ON ad.attr_value = ada.attr_value
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ac.attr_type, ac.attr_value, 1.0 * (act.total_after - ac.total_before) / ac.total_before * 100 as pct_change
    FROM attr_customer_types ac JOIN attr_customer_types_after act ON ac.attr_value = act.attr_value
)
SELECT attr_type, ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 2) as avg_pct_change
FROM all_changes
GROUP BY attr_type
ORDER BY avg_pct_change

-- Normalize paths by removing trailing slashes, then find landing and exit pages
WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        session, 
        stamp, 
        CASE WHEN path = '' THEN '' ELSE RTRIM(path, '/') END AS path
    FROM activity_log
),
landing AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, path
    FROM normalized
    WHERE (session, stamp) IN (
        SELECT session, MIN(stamp)
        FROM normalized
        GROUP BY session
    )
),
exit_pages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, path
    FROM normalized
    WHERE (session, stamp) IN (
        SELECT session, MAX(stamp)
        FROM normalized
        GROUP BY session
    )
),
page_sessions AS (
    SELECT session, path FROM landing
    UNION
    SELECT session, path FROM exit_pages
)
SELECT path, COUNT(DISTINCT session) as session_count
FROM page_sessions
GROUP BY path

WITH distinct_activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT stamp, session, action, option, path, search_type
    FROM activity_log
),
session_first_conversion AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_conversion_stamp
    FROM distinct_activity
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/detail/', '/complete', '/complete/')
    GROUP BY session
),
session_pre_events AS (
    SELECT 
        sfc.session,
        da.path,
        da.search_type
    FROM session_first_conversion sfc
    JOIN distinct_activity da ON da.session = sfc.session AND da.stamp < sfc.first_conversion_stamp
    WHERE da.search_type != ''
),
session_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        sfc.session,
        COUNT(spe.path) AS pre_event_count
    FROM session_first_conversion sfc
    LEFT JOIN session_pre_events spe ON spe.session = sfc.session
    GROUP BY sfc.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_event_count) AS min_count
    FROM session_counts
)
SELECT sc.session, 
       spe.path, 
       spe.search_type
FROM session_counts sc
CROSS JOIN min_count mc
LEFT JOIN session_pre_events spe ON spe.session = sc.session
WHERE sc.pre_event_count = mc.min_count
ORDER BY sc.session

-- OK so there are 75 pairs on lap 2. Let me check how many of those flipped
WITH prev AS (
    SELECT driver_id, position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE race_id = 1 AND lap_type = 'Race' AND lap = 1
),
curr AS (
    SELECT driver_id, position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE race_id = 1 AND lap_type = 'Race' AND lap = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as overtakes
FROM prev p_a
JOIN prev p_b ON p_a.position < p_b.position AND p_a.driver_id < p_b.driver_id
JOIN curr c_a ON c_a.driver_id = p_a.driver_id
JOIN curr c_b ON c_b.driver_id = p_b.driver_id
WHERE c_a.position > c_b.position

-- For each race and each lap transition (0->1, 1->2, 2->3, 3->4, 4->5),
-- find all overtakes using the adjacent positions approach
-- This is more efficient because we only look at adjacent positions

-- Let's first test with race 18, lap 0->1
-- For each position p on lap 0, get driver at p and driver at p+1
-- On lap 1, if driver at p+1 is now ahead of driver at p, that's an overtake

WITH lap0 AS (
    SELECT driver_id, position FROM lap_positions WHERE race_id = 18 AND lap = 0
),
lap1 AS (
    SELECT driver_id, position FROM lap_positions WHERE race_id = 18 AND lap = 1 AND lap_type = 'Race'
),
adjacent_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        a.driver_id AS driver_a,
        b.driver_id AS driver_b,
        a.position AS pos_a,
        b.position AS pos_b  -- pos_b = pos_a + 1
    FROM lap0 a
    JOIN lap0 b ON a.position + 1 = b.position
)
SELECT 
    ap.driver_a,
    ap.driver_b,
    ap.pos_a,
    ap.pos_b,
    l1a.position AS lap1_pos_a,
    l1b.position AS lap1_pos_b
FROM adjacent_pairs ap
JOIN lap1 l1a ON l1a.driver_id = ap.driver_a
JOIN lap1 l1b ON l1b.driver_id = ap.driver_b
WHERE l1a.position > l1b.position  -- driver_b overtook driver_a
LIMIT 30

WITH season_points AS (

),
min_points AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_pts
    FROM season_points
    GROUP BY year
),
fewest_per_season AS (
    SELECT sp.year, sp.constructor_id, sp.constructor_name, sp.total_points
    FROM season_points sp
    JOIN min_points mp ON sp.year = mp.year AND sp.total_points = mp.min_pts
)
SELECT constructor_name, COUNT(*) as num_seasons
FROM fewest_per_season
GROUP BY constructor_name
ORDER BY num_seasons DESC, constructor_name ASC

-- Get the top driver and constructor per year (final standings)
WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
top_driver AS (
    SELECT lr.year, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as full_name, ds.points, ds.driver_id
    FROM last_race lr
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    WHERE ds.position = 1
),
top_constructor AS (
    SELECT lr.year, c.name as constructor_name, cs.points, cs.constructor_id
    FROM last_race lr
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id = cs.constructor_id
    WHERE cs.position = 1
)
SELECT td.year, td.full_name as top_driver, td.points as driver_points, tc.constructor_name as top_constructor, tc.points as constructor_points
FROM top_driver td
JOIN top_constructor tc ON td.year = tc.year
ORDER BY td.year

WITH driver_points AS (
  SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_driver_points
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
),
constructor_points AS (
  SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_constructor_points
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
),
driver_max AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(total_driver_points) AS max_driver_points
  FROM driver_points
  GROUP BY year
),
constructor_max AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(total_constructor_points) AS max_constructor_points
  FROM constructor_points
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT dm.year, dm.max_driver_points, cm.max_constructor_points, dm.max_driver_points + cm.max_constructor_points AS combined_total
FROM driver_max dm
JOIN constructor_max cm ON dm.year = cm.year
ORDER BY combined_total ASC
LIMIT 10

-- Get top 3 combined points
WITH last_race_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) as max_round
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
last_races AS (
    SELECT r.race_id, r.year, r.round
    FROM races r
    JOIN last_race_per_year lry ON r.year = lry.year AND r.round = lry.max_round
),
constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.race_id
),
driver_constructor_points AS (
    SELECT res.constructor_id, r.year, res.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname,
           SUM(res.points) as driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
    GROUP BY res.constructor_id, r.year, res.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname
),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, year, driver_id, forename, surname, driver_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, constructor_id ORDER BY driver_points DESC) as rn
    FROM driver_constructor_points
),
combined AS (
    SELECT csp.year, csp.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, csp.constructor_points,
           bd.driver_id, bd.forename, bd.surname, bd.driver_points,
           csp.constructor_points + bd.driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_season_points csp
    JOIN best_driver bd ON csp.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id AND csp.year = bd.year AND bd.rn = 1
    JOIN constructors c ON csp.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM combined
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Unique drivers with the stricter interpretation (only one constructor all season)
WITH driver_races AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id, r.round
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_season AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, 
           MIN(round) as first_round, 
           MAX(round) as last_round,
           COUNT(DISTINCT round) as num_rounds,
           COUNT(DISTINCT constructor_id) as num_constructors
    FROM driver_races
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round) >= 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname
FROM driver_season
JOIN drivers d ON driver_season.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE num_constructors = 1
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename

SELECT r.year, r.round, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
WHERE r.year = 2019 AND res.driver_id = 842
ORDER BY r.round

-- Let's look at a specific race to understand the data better
WITH race_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE race_id = 1 AND lap_type = 'Race'
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT 
        r1.race_id,
        r1.driver_id,
        r1.lap AS prev_lap,
        r1.position AS prev_pos,
        r2.lap AS curr_lap,
        r2.position AS curr_pos
    FROM race_laps r1
    JOIN race_laps r2 
        ON r1.race_id = r2.race_id 
        AND r1.driver_id = r2.driver_id
        AND r2.lap = r1.lap + 1
    WHERE r1.lap >= 2
)
SELECT race_id, driver_id, prev_lap, prev_pos, curr_lap, curr_pos,
       CASE WHEN curr_pos < prev_pos THEN 'overtook'
            WHEN curr_pos > prev_pos THEN 'overtaken'
            ELSE 'same' END AS change_type
FROM consecutive
WHERE curr_pos != prev_pos
ORDER BY curr_lap, prev_pos
LIMIT 40
